title: Reboot Protocol Nexus
storyContext: Aethelgard's command bridge needs immediate initialization. The automated bootloader is waiting for three lines of formatted telemetry to engage life support and reactor turbines.
objective:
Write a Python script that outputs exactly three lines to the console:
Line 1: STATION: AETHELGARD
Line 2: REACTOR_LEVEL: 100
Line 3: PROTOCOL_STATUS: ONLINE
starterCode:
# CODEQUEST MISSION 01: Reboot Protocol Nexus
# Systems Engineer: You
# AI Companion: ARIA

# Broadcast the 3 diagnostic lines using print():
# 1. STATION: AETHELGARD
# 2. REACTOR_LEVEL: 100
# 3. PROTOCOL_STATUS: ONLINE

hints.title: Concept Reminder
hints.content: Python uses the built-in print() function to write text or numbers to standard output.

hints.title: Logical Direction
hints.content: Invoke print(...) three separate times in sequence. Each print invocation automatically writes a new line.

hints.title: Partial Pseudocode
hints.content:
print("STATION: AETHELGARD")
print("REACTOR_LEVEL: 100")
# Now add the third call for PROTOCOL_STATUS: ONLINE

environmentEffectOnPass.message: Power Grid Synchronized. Bridge Lighting Restored.
